kind: complex Finsler torsion and adapted vertical calculus
scope: Strongly pseudoconvex complex Finsler tangent metrics in every n>=1. Adapted vertical fields commute; a homogeneous skew-contraction lemma proves weak Kähler equivalence retaining the Gi pairing. A separate nonlinear-coefficient calculation proves Kähler equivalence with strong Kähler. The Hermitian specialization recovers d omega=0.

analytic_review_obligations.zero-extension: Complex homogeneity and a bounded sphere restriction give continuous F=0 at the zero section locally in the base.
analytic_review_obligations.Euler-from-complex-scaling: Positive real scaling and phase rotation imply v^jG_j=G, v^jG_ja=0 and Gi=H_ibar a barva.

analytic_review_obligations.adapted-actions: Djv^k=delta_j^k and DjGk=0, using the inverse identities.
analytic_review_obligations.vertical-bracket: The bracket is vertical and annihilates every coframe member, hence is zero.

analytic_review_obligations.T-homogeneity: T transforms by barc; its holomorphic Euler derivative vanishes.
analytic_review_obligations.weak-equivalence: The homogeneous-skew lemma removes only the v contraction and retains the Gi pairing.
analytic_review_obligations.weak-converse: Recontracting T=0 gives the weak condition.
analytic_review_obligations.nonlinear-homogeneity: N transforms by c, since H has weight(0,0) and G_bar a;k has weight(1,0).
analytic_review_obligations.Gamma-derivative: Differentiating H inverse and commuting fibre derivatives gives Gamma^i_j;k=partial_vj N^i_k.
analytic_review_obligations.strong-reduction: The Kähler contraction and Euler N give 2N_k=partial_vk(vjNj).

analytic_review_obligations.strong-converse: Full horizontal torsion zero implies its v contraction zero.
analytic_review_obligations.Hermitian-specialization: Tjk=(h_jbar a;k-h_kbar a;j)barva; coefficients independent of v therefore vanish separately.
analytic_review_obligations.Hermitian-closedness: Those holomorphic derivative identities and their conjugates give d omega_h=0.
analytic_review_obligations.dimension-one: Skew tensors vanish identically for n=1; formulas and inverses remain defined.
analytic_review_obligations.local-to-global: Each coordinate computation proves the invariant Chern-Finsler torsion conditions in every chart.
analytic_review_obligations.positivity-boundary: Fibre H>0 does not assert real strong convexity, total-space psh, curvature signs or complement indices.
